ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (central lobes) to low-intensity black pixels (trailing edges and mottling).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous geometric zones on inner lobes; continuous thick black band bordering the entire trailing edge; singular circular dark spot on upper-left lobe; frequent vertical dark linear streaks distributed across both white surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute pixel-angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular topography with frequent high-amplitude peaks and valleys; notable deep traumatic indentation on the mid-trailing edge of the left lobe; right lobe exhibits consistent high-frequency saw-tooth serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced upward convex curve originating at the median notch and tapering to textured, narrow distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast textured clusters (barnacle colonization) localized at the extreme tips of both lobes; single dark focal cluster on the upper quadrant of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous distinct, unaligned vertical and diagonal dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) breaking the white pigmentation on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major traumatic notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe lobe; significant textured build-up (parasitic/crustacean) on the distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific pattern of vertical rake marks combined with a singular, isolated dark circular spot on the left lobe creates a unique visual fingerprint.
